summary: Frontend-only testing for Phase 2A.1: app boots on web preview, but authenticated chat flow was not reachable in automation, and direct chat route with invalid conversationId throws a Convex runtime error in ChatScreen.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping Sign In did not navigate to auth provider/auth-webview in 3 automation attempts; first attempt logged 'Auth request not ready yet'.

integration_issues.issue: Navigating to /chat/test-conversation triggers Convex query server error (conversations:getConversation) and ChatScreen crashes into error boundary instead of graceful fallback.
Could not validate because auth flow was not reachable in automation session.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-notifications web warning persists ('listening to push token changes not fully supported on web') plus shadow* deprecation warnings; non-blocking but noisy during QA.

action_items: Fix Sign In readiness/trigger path on web: ensure promptAsync is only callable when request/discovery are ready, and expose a visible loading/disabled state for sign-in-btn.
Harden app/chat/[conversationId].tsx query handling (invalid/missing/unauthorized conversationId) to avoid red-screen style runtime crash and show safe fallback UI.

After auth is reachable, retest Phase 2A.1 end-to-end: long-press message sheet actions, reaction chips, reply preview pill, quoted reply render, forward modal, copy, delete placeholder, haptics behavior on supported platforms.
critical_code_review_comments: app/chat/[conversationId].tsx calls api.conversations.getConversation directly from route param; invalid IDs currently bubble a Convex server error to UI without guard.
Long-press action features are wired with testIDs (message-action-sheet, action-*) and look testable once authenticated flow is reachable.
expo-clipboard dependency pin request is satisfied: package.json has expo-clipboard '~8.0.8'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials file exists and references Google OIDC account only (no app password). Auth is currently not automatable in this run due non-progressing sign-in flow. Per loop-prevention rule, stopped after 3 sign-in selector attempts.
rca_of_issue: Repro 1: Open /chat/test-conversation directly -> console shows '[CONVEX Q(conversations:getConversation)] Server Error' and ChatScreen does not render stable fallback. Repro 2: Tap sign-in-btn from root -> first attempt logs 'Auth request not ready yet'; later attempts still remain on root with no auth navigation/popup. Mitigation: add explicit request-ready gating/disabled UI for sign-in, and add defensive error handling for chat query failures in chat route.
